input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: The Software conformance warranty period (one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, extended while maintenance continues) meets the preferred 12-month position, and there is no implied-warranty disclaimer or "AS IS" language anywhere in the agreement, so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty (Section 15 limits damages only). However, the warranty is incomplete: (i) no remedy is attached to it — repair is available only as a Maintenance Service under Section 10 (p0077), which is fee-bearing and could lapse, and the Section 7/8 refund is confined to the acceptance period; (ii) there is no professional and workmanlike warranty covering installation, data conversion, training and maintenance services; and (iii) there are no malicious code or legal compliance warranties. We therefore insert a single paragraph in Section 12 adding the services warranty, malicious code/compliance warranties and a repair/replace-then-refund remedy, and confirming the warranty is not displaced by Section 10 maintenance.

ops.text: Garman further warrants that (a) all services provided under this Agreement, including installation, data conversion, training and Maintenance Services, shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (b) the Software and such services shall comply with all applicable laws; and (c) the Software shall not contain any virus, disabling device or other malicious code. Sparkling's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 12 shall be, at Garman's option, re-performance, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Software or services at no charge to Sparkling, and if Garman fails to do so within 30 business days of written notice, a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Software or services. The warranties in this Section 12 are in addition to, and not limited or displaced by, the Maintenance Services described in Section 10.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 12 gives a one-year Software conformance warranty but no stated warranty remedy, no services warranty and no malicious-code or legal-compliance warranty, and repair is currently available only under the paid maintenance arrangement in Section 10. We have added a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus a repair/replace-then-refund remedy, consistent with our standard warranty position; if helpful we can accept a 90-day services warranty period.
proposal.summary: Add services warranty, malicious code and legal compliance warranties, and an express repair/replace/refund remedy to Section 12.
